title: Tenant sites are eventually consistent with a TTL; no per-edit CloudFront purge
description:
What: the shared stack serves with a TTL and versioned object keys; purging is rare and batched, not per edit. States the freshness promise in docs. Builds on PPY-409932.
Acceptance:
Scenario: An edit appears within the TTL with no invalidation
  Given a tenant edits a page
  When the TTL passes
  Then readers see the edit and no invalidation request was made

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented on the shared stack by PPY-ca247b. Finding: today a publish touching more than 10 paths becomes one '/*' invalidation (docs/site-hosting.md); on a shared distribution that would empty every tenant's cache, so the shared stack never collapses to a wildcard. Whether a purge can be limited to one tenant is question 1 of PPY-3b3cc3.
